capabilities: Capture a rectangular region of any open tab as an image
Embed the captured image directly in the note text at the cursor
Link each snip back to its source page, PDF page, or note
Configure image format, quality, resolution, and selection-line appearance
Trigger snipping from the command palette with a hotkey
extras: Desktop only; Electron screen capture is unavailable on mobile, though notes with snips still display them there. Each snip adds 20-150 KB to the note body, which can slow opening and searching of very large notes.
intentEvidence: It works like the "copy embed link to rectangular selection" button in PDF++, but for every tab
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to grab a visual snippet from an arbitrary tab and place it in a note without creating a separate attachment file.

relations.evidence: It works like the "copy embed link to rectangular selection" button in PDF++, but for every tab

summary: Region screenshot tool that captures part of any open tab (web page, PDF, graph, canvas) and embeds it as an image stored inside the note itself.
